# Animal–Computer Interaction (ACI)

ACI research asks how an animal's actions may be sensed, interpreted and responded to through computing systems. Here the package provides **measurement and audit utilities**, not independent evidence of animal agency, preference or welfare.

<figure class="aqt-figure"><img src="../aci.svg" alt="Schematic animal–computer feedback loop from observed fish action through controller gate and actuator telemetry to review." loading="lazy"></figure>

<p class="aqt-figure-caption">Conceptual only. The illustrated control loop must not be interpreted as an independently certified live hardware safety system.</p>

## Event and latency telemetry

The ACI functions help audit external time-stamped data across behaviour, detection, command, actuator and response events.

- [`aqt_aci_trials()`](../reference/aqt_aci_trials.html): declared interaction trials.
- [`aqt_aci_loop_metrics()`](../reference/aqt_aci_loop_metrics.html): completeness and correctness of observed interaction loops.
- [`aqt_aci_latency_summary()`](../reference/aqt_aci_latency_summary.html): reaction and device/loop latencies.

Distinguish detected false triggers, missing actuator acknowledgements and true observed response. Event timing must be validated externally.

## Choice and access

- [`aqt_aci_choice_log()`](../reference/aqt_aci_choice_log.html): choices and **actual options offered**.
- [`aqt_aci_choice_summary()`](../reference/aqt_aci_choice_summary.html): descriptive option selection patterns.
- [`aqt_aci_access_inequality()`](../reference/aqt_aci_access_inequality.html): account for unequal access to real multi-option choice opportunities.

Choice frequency does not prove an animal's conscious preference or welfare benefit.

## From simulation to responsible experiments

Use the existing local/offline software dry-run and logging protocols for engineering research. Any physical controller needs its **own** ethics, operator approval, emergency-stop verification, failure containment and biological review.

A static GitHub Pages site cannot actuate physical equipment. No remote live-device control interface is included here.

**Read:** [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/ACI_CLOSED_LOOP_TELEMETRY.md), [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/ACI_CHOICE_AND_ACCESS.md) and [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/ACI_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROTOCOL.md).
